thesis.core: 2026Q3 disclosure reverses the apparent H1 recovery: nine-month attributable earnings are negative, deducted earnings negative, and group earnings accrue primarily to minority interests. Receivable collections improved operating cash flow but capex still exceeds it. Large discounted book value is not sufficient to support a defensive-stability thesis without sustainable attributable returns and project cash distributions.
thesis.variant_wedge: The stock trades at about 0.44x attributable book value, but book value is embedded in long-duration infrastructure/project assets with credit, capital intensity and parent-cash-remittance uncertainty; the discount is not automatically a margin of safety.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Use 2026Q3 attributable BVPS RMB7.529 and conservative recovery-sensitive PB rather than mechanically annualizing near-zero/negative 9M attributable EPS. This is a conditional valuation, not proof of recoverable asset value.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: CFO collection improvement is real but cannot be equated with distributable FCF; 9M CFO less purchases of long-term assets is negative. Credit impairment RMB229.79m and interest expense RMB653.96m weigh on earnings. Minority interests absorb essentially all reported group profit.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: PB is a conditional asset-recovery sensitivity only; no positive normalized earnings is underwritten given nine-month attributable and deducted losses. No automatic promotion if valuation-only entry threshold is crossed.

catalysts: Verified sustained attributable operating profit and positive post-maintenance-capex owner cash flow, not merely receivable collection timing.
Reduction of leverage and related-party/guarantee exposure with transparent project-level cash distribution.
Successful asset disposals at or above independently verified recoverable value with meaningful debt reduction.
kill_thesis: Persistent attributable or deducted losses despite reported group profit.
CFO improvement fails to cover maintenance and growth capex or is primarily working-capital timing.
Credit impairments, project receivable recoverability or refinancing costs deteriorate.
Disposal of subsidiary equity leaves material residual guarantees or loss of cash-generating assets without adequate consideration.
